prompt: Deliver box1 from shelf_a to the table with arm1. But someone may take box1 before the run starts: if it is missing, move nothing and tell the fleet on channel "alerts" that box1 is missing; if it is there, deliver it.
why: Needs one program that acts differently depending on a world fact at run time (deliver, or else report). RoboLang 1.3 has no if/else: `pre` can only stop a run when a condition is false, and a stopped run sends nothing.
